MaintenanceRecord.title: MaintenanceRecord
MaintenanceRecord.description: A record of a maintenance task.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this record.

name.description: The name of the maintenance task.

category.description: The category of the maintenance task.

periodicity.description: How often the task should be performed.

lastDate.description: The date the task was last performed (ISO string).

nextDate.description: The date the task is next due (ISO string).

status.description: The current status of the task.

createdAt.description: The date the record was created (ISO string).

completedAt.description: The date the task was completed (ISO string).

cost.description: The cost of the maintenance task.

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether notifications are enabled for this task.

CategoryDefinition.title: CategoryDefinition
CategoryDefinition.description: A custom category for maintenance tasks.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this category.

icon.description: The icon identifier for the category.

color.description: The color class for the category.

/records/{recordId}.description: Stores maintenance records for all users.

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Stores custom categories for all users.
